descriptions.zh: 将一个条件访问策略从启用状态变为禁用状态时，条件访问策略将不再拦截，请确认您已知该操作可能导致的风险。
descriptions.en: When you change a conditional access policy from enabled to disabled, the policy no longer intercepts requests. Confirm that you are aware of the risks that this operation may cause.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam enable-conditional-access-policy --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --conditional-access-policy-id cap_11111 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam EnableConditionalAccessPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ConditionalAccessPolicyId cap_11111
